tasks.title: Setup Next.js Project with Authentication
tasks.description: Initialize the Next.js project with responsive design framework and implement authentication system for multiple user types (agents, managers, admin).
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js project using `npx create-next-app@latest`
2. Set up TypeScript configuration
3. Implement responsive design using Tailwind CSS
4. Integrate NextAuth.js for authentication
5. Create user models for agents, managers, and admin roles
6. Implement login, registration, and password recovery flows
7. Set up protected routes based on user roles
8. Create middleware for authentication verification
9. Design and implement responsive navigation that adapts to user role
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for authentication functions
2. Integration tests for login/logout flows
3. E2E tests for protected routes
4. Responsive design testing across multiple device sizes
5. Role-based access control testing

tasks.title: Database Schema and API Setup
tasks.description: Design and implement database schema for leads, properties, appointments, and user data. Create API endpoints for CRUD operations.
tasks.details:
1. Set up database connection using Prisma ORM
2. Design database schema with the following models:
   - Users (agents, managers, admin)
   - Leads (contact info, source, status, notes)
   - Properties (details, photos, pricing, status)
   - Appointments (viewings, calls, meetings)
   - Activities (tracking interactions)
3. Create API routes for each model using Next.js API routes
4. Implement middleware for request validation
5. Set up proper error handling and response formatting
6. Implement pagination for list endpoints
7. Create database migrations and seeding scripts
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for database models
2. API endpoint testing with Jest
3. Data validation testing
4. Performance testing for queries
5. Database migration testing
